description: Defines the ListedService class which manages listed accounts, authorization, and related API interactions within the application.

classes.name: ListedService
classes.description: A service class that handles listing accounts, authorization, and account info retrieval, implementing the ListedClientInterface.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up references and calls superclass deinit.

methods.name: canRegisterNewListedAccount
methods.description: Checks if a new listed account can be registered based on user presence.

methods.name: isNoteAuthorizedForListed
methods.description: Checks if a note is authorized for listed publishing.

methods.name: authorizeNoteForListed
methods.description: Authorizes a note for listed publishing after user authorization.

methods.name: requestNewListedAccount
methods.description: Requests creation of a new listed account, polling the server until success or max attempts.

methods.name: getListedAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves all listed accounts, including settings-based and legacy accounts.

methods.name: getListedAccountInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed info for a specific listed account, optionally in the context of an item.

methods.name: getSettingsBasedListedAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves listed accounts stored in settings.

methods.name: getLegacyListedAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves legacy listed accounts from item extensions.
